title: Obere Karlstraße, Erlangen
description: Centrally located, beautifully furnished, three room apartment in a charming listed house in the city of Erlangen. Long Term Stays: More than 3 Months : better conditions ! The stunning palace park, university library and clinics are in the immediate vicinity. Stucco ceiling, wooden floors, new kitchen, new bathroom, washing machine, dishwasher, WLAN, TV, complete kitchen equipment with toaster, microwave, kettle, Nespresso coffee machine etc. make this place the perfect location for any foreigner looking to settle in and get to know Germany/Erlangen by living in a historic yet restored and renovated house.The train station is within 5 minutes walking distance and it is only 200 meters to the pedestrian zone that offers plenty of shops, coffee shops, restaurants. . Disclaimer: This apartment will not be rented out for turistic purposes, the minimum rental time is 2 month. Possibility to sit outside in quiet, green backyard. Safe area!

title: Westliche Stadtmauerstraße, Erlangen
description:
Hello, this is a private room in a shared apartment for rent. There are 4 rooms altogether, two bathrooms and a large kitchen. Two rooms have balconies and there is a garden, that can be used as well.
 Tha apartment is located right 150m north of the railway station, it is 3 minutes away from the city center with all kinds of possibilities for shopping, eating, dining, doctors, pharmacies und right behind the Schlossplatz there is a large park to stay there. Let me know, when you need additional informations.
